page.content:
Four-year-lifespan replicant generation of 2019.

How Nexus-6 connects

  • Faction: Replicants — Nexus-6 is Tyrell's four-year replicant generation.
  • Character: Roy Batty — Roy is a Nexus-6 combat model.

What is Nexus-6?

Nexus-6 is Tyrell's combat-and-labor generation with a built-in four-year life — Roy, Pris, Leon, Zhora — stronger and smarter than the hunters.

Key threads lead to Replicants and Roy Batty.
